tagline: Create Asana tasks from Slack and track progress in chat
metaTitle: Slack + Asana Integration: Asana Tasks from Slack
metaDescription: Turn Slack requests into tracked work. GAIA creates Asana tasks from Slack messages and sends a daily standup digest to the channel. See the setup steps.
intro: Project teams coordinate in Slack but track work in Asana. The gap between the two means tasks get agreed upon in conversation but never formally created, and project updates don't reach the team in chat. GAIA closes this loop so your team can keep coordinating in chat while maintaining proper project tracking.

useCases.title: Create tasks from Slack messages
useCases.description: React to any Slack message with a task emoji or GAIA command to create an Asana task without leaving the conversation. GAIA uses the message content as the task description and prompts for due date and assignee.

useCases.title: Task completion notifications
useCases.description: When a task is completed, GAIA notifies the relevant channel or thread so teammates know work is done without manually checking the project.

useCases.title: Daily project standup digest
useCases.description: GAIA compiles a morning summary of tasks due today and overdue tasks and posts it to the team channel to align everyone on daily priorities.

useCases.title: Blocked task alerts
useCases.description: When a task is marked blocked, GAIA sends an alert to the task owner and project manager so blockers get attention quickly.

useCases.title: Milestone celebration posts
useCases.description: When a project milestone is reached, GAIA posts a celebratory update to the team channel recognizing contributors and announcing the achievement.

howItWorks.step: Connect Slack and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Add GAIA to your Slack workspace and connect your Asana account with access to the relevant workspaces and projects.

howItWorks.step: Map each channel to a project
howItWorks.description: Tell GAIA which channels correspond to which projects so tasks created from messages automatically go to the right project.
Set which task events should notify which channels. Start with task completion and due-date reminders, then add more events as needed.

faqs.question: Can I update Asana task details from Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA in chat to update a task's due date, assignee, description, or status. GAIA confirms the change and updates the task in real time.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with templates and custom fields?
faqs.answer: GAIA can create tasks from templates and populate custom fields if you specify them in your instructions. Advanced custom field automation may require initial configuration.

faqs.question: Can multiple channels map to the same project?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multiple channels can feed into the same project, which is useful when different teams contribute to the same project from their own channels.
